title: Serial Dilution of Nucleofected iPSC Pools
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x76frre
materials: Aspirate media from cells in culture.

steps.title: Coat Plate Wells
steps.instruction: Coat 3 wells of a 6 well plate with 1 mL Matrigel supplemented with RGD fragment.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with 1 mL - 2 mL PBS per well.

steps.title: Dissociate Cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Accutase per well and incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes to achieve single cells.

substeps.instruction: Monitor cells regularly to identify when single cells are achieved, as individual donor lines exhibit variable sensitivity to accutase-mediated dissociation.

steps.title: Collect and Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells in 5 mL DMEM/F12, transfer to a 15mL conical tube, and centrifuge.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in mTesR1 supplemented with 5 uM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Plate Serial Dilutions
steps.instruction: Plate several dilutions of cells over the three wells in 2 mL of mTesR1.

substeps.instruction: Typically use volumes of 25 μl, 50 μl, and 75 μl.

steps.title: Freeze Remaining Cells
steps.instruction: Freeze down the remaining cells by adding an equal volume of 2x iPSC Freezing Media (20% DMSO in FBS).
